title: High--$T_c$ RF SQUIDs with Large Inductance of Quantization Loop
abstract: Experimental data on signal and noise characteristics of high--$T_c$ RF SQUIDs with large inductance of quantization loop are presented. The SQUIDs were produced by a thick--film HTS--technique of painting on the Y$_2$BaCuO$_5$ substrate. For the first time, a steady quantum interference was observed in RF SQUID with the inductance as large as $L_S=6.6$ nH, that is, 60 times higher than the fluctuation inductance $L_F\simeq10^{-10}H$ at the liquid nitrogen temperature T=77 K. A new method is offered to evaluate the sensitivity of RF SQUID with optimum inductance of the quantization loop.
